Ajay K.: quick heads-up — I have a small repro for a bundler interop issue hitting our JS SDK on edge runtimes.
Ajay K.: gist: https://github.com/redwood-internal/repro-esbuild-edge (private sampleapp)
Ajay K.: repro summary: build with esbuild (via vite/esbuild plugin) -> deploy to edge (deno/edge runtime) -> requests start failing auth with 401 even though token present.
Maria L.: oof. does it happen with rollup/webpack builds too?
Ajay K.: only reproducible when esbuild produces a CJS-style bundle or when vite/esbuild config uses `format: 'cjs'`/commonjs fallback. webpack/rollup esm builds look fine.
Ben R.: can you paste the minimal error / stack?
Ajay K.: log from edge runtime: 
```
ERROR: Request to /api/generate failed: 401 Unauthorized
at fetch (edge-runtime:internal)
at SDK.request (/workspace/node_modules/@redwood-inference/sdk/dist/index.js:96:12)
TypeError: sdk.generate is not a function
```
Ajay K.: local node build (esm) works; the CJS build seems to change the default export shape so our SDK's `default` vs named export mapping breaks in runtime.
Olivia: oh i bet esbuild's `exports`/`default` interop is causing `module.exports = { default: ... }` vs `exports.default =` differences.
Samir: also worth checking that the bundler isn't tree-shaking the auth wrapper. I've seen env var inlining remove optional code paths.
Ajay K.: reproduction steps (minimal):
1) git clone https://github.com/redwood-internal/repro-esbuild-edge && cd repro-esbuild-edge
2) npm i
3) # two build variants
   npm run build:esm # vite -> format: 'esm' (works)
   npm run build:cjs # esbuild/vite build -> format: 'cjs' (fails)
4) deploy to our edge runner (or run `deno task start:edge`)
5) curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" https://edge.example/_gen -> 401 and runtime TypeError

Ajay K.: vite config snippet that triggers it:
```js
// vite.config.js
import { defineConfig } from 'vite'
import esbuild from 'esbuild'
export default defineConfig({
  build: {
    rollupOptions: {},
    // setting this to 'cjs' for compatibility with some plugins
    commonjsOptions: { transformMixedEsModules: true },
    modulePreload: false,
    target: 'es2020',
    lib: {
      entry: 'src/index.ts',
      formats: ['cjs']
    }
  }
})
```
Ajay K.: workaround: force ESM bundle (formats: ['es']) or add an explicit interop shim: `const SDK = require('./dist').default || require('./dist')` — ugly though.
Maria L.: typings? does TS consumer hit wrong types because default vs named?
Ben R.: yes — TS users who `import Redwood from '@redwood-inference/sdk'` get mismatched type for `Redwood` when the runtime becomes CJS. `esModuleInterop` and `allowSyntheticDefaultImports` mask it locally but breaks for consumers using strict setups.
Olivia: do we have an SDK build note that recommends `exports` field in package.json and shipping ESM + CJS properly?
Ajay K.: package.json currently has `main` pointing to cjs bundle and `module` to esm, but esbuild's transform still yields a different shape when tools rewrite `module.exports` vs `export default`. Edge runtime uses the CJS path because of how the deploy tool resolves.
Samir: CI note: I wrote a quick test that builds both formats and runs a tiny edge emulation; can push to the repro repo if helpful.
ci-bot: build #4821 (esbuild-edge-repro) completed — artifacts uploaded to https://artifacts.internal/repro/4821/
Maria L.: action items: 1) update SDK build to ensure `default` compatibility (interop wrapper) 2) add repro to devex docs 3) add a small integration test that builds with esbuild+vite cjs and runs edge smoke test.
Ajay K.: also adding a short checklist for devs encountering auth 401 on edge: check that the generated bundle preserves `fetch` wrapper and that `Authorization` header isn't being stripped by edge layer; run `node --input-type=module` locally to validate ESM behavior.
Ben R.: i can take (1) — i'll try adding a tiny interop wrapper at package entrypoint that normalizes exports: `module.exports = exports.default ? exports.default : exports` and publish a patch in canary.
Olivia: and i'll update docs and onboarding sampleapp to use `formats: ['es']` by default and note pitfalls with `commonjsOptions.transformMixedEsModules`.
Samir: thanks all — please ping me if you want the CI edge runner hooked into PRs for the SDK so we catch this earlier.
Ajay K.: thanks — will open PR with repro link + failing CI job so it's easy to review. :thumbsup:
